subject: integration
name: EthFS standard (ETHFS_0_1)
summary: Defines reading files kept on Ethereum in EthFS and storing them with transactions the person signs. Reads check every byte against the address naming it; only which address a filename maps to rests on the answering node, and nothing here checks that. A write plans the transactions, asks the person once for the whole series and shows the sending address on the chain for good. The row runs nothing and connects to nothing; the node that answers is judged on its own row. Level 4 with privacy: a pure definition. Judged here by its publisher.
